caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a woman, showing her from the head to just above the waist. The woman has light skin and shoulder-length, dark brown hair that is parted in the middle and waves outward. Her lips are a muted pink, and her eyes are blue. She is dressed in a period-style outfit with a bodice that is cream-colored at the top, decorated with lace and ruffles, and transitions to a muted gold and greenish-blue hue below. Across her chest, there is a string of red beads forming a necklace, and she wears a second accessory: a gold-colored chain draped diagonally around her shoulders and chest. There is a red flower with green leaves placed at the center of her chest, above her bodice. Over her shoulders, she has a dark green shawl or wrap, and her skirt or lower garment, visible only at the waist, is blue-grey with vertical folds. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects present in the composition.
title: Figurehead: "Emma"
